cited.quote: Welfare Schemes for Handloom and Powerloom Weavers

rationale: C1-C4 describe existing handloom/powerloom schemes (rebate, modernisation, pensions, welfare boards) but none shows an annual Rs.30,000 assistance to each loom-owning weaver family. Related activity only; no official step for this commitment.

cited.quote: Accident Insurance Scheme a. In case of Accidental Death 1,00,000/-

rationale: C1-C3 cover weaver pensions, awards and a Khadi welfare board accident cover of Rs.1 lakh (C3), not Rs.10 lakh life insurance for all weavers. C4-C5 are a health insurance GO for government employees. No official step for the commitment.

cited.quote: this Government will identify poor families in Tamil Nadu and ensure that Government’s welfare schemes reach them

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) states the intent to identify poor families and ensure schemes reach them; this is a statement of intent, not an official step. C2-C5 show related welfare and housing plans, not an identification exercise or GO for it.

cited.quote: the Government provides a monthly honorarium of ₹25,000/- to 980 Special Educators (703) / Therapists (277)

rationale: C1 and C4 describe special educators in NGO-run special schools and special schools generally; C2-C3 cover general teacher recruitment. None shows appointment of a dedicated special-children teacher in every government school.

cited.quote: provide compensation of five lakh rupees to the 109 family of the deceased workers

rationale: C1 is a Rs.5 lakh compensation scheme for fireworks and match factory workers, a different group. C2 covers safety training for construction workers. No extract shows Rs.5 lakh accident insurance for registered construction workers.

cited.quote: Integrated senior citizen homes, fully equipped with essential amenities including qualified caregivers, medical personnel

rationale: C1 and C2 concern senior citizen welfare (day care centres, homes, helpline) and C5 concerns mobile service vans for ambulances. None shows mobile senior citizen clinics being started. Related activity only.

cited.quote: Rs.3,400 for anganwadi workers, Rs.3,200 for mini anganwadi workers and Rs.3,000 for anganwadi helpers.

rationale: C1 and C3 discuss anganwadi employees' pensions, benefits and duties, but no extract shows a Rs.10,000 monthly salary for anganwadi assistants or ASHA workers. No official step.

cited.quote: Every year, senior citizens aged between 60 and 70 are taken on spiritual pilgrimages funded by the Government.

rationale: C1 reports an existing pilgrimage programme for seniors aged 60-70 with no scale given; C2 covers small minority pilgrimage subsidies. No new step to take 2.5 lakh seniors annually to destinations of their choice.

cited.quote: (60 to 79 years) Rs.200 Rs.1000 Rs.1200 1. Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme

rationale: C1 shows the old age pension at Rs.1200 per month (July 2026 data). No extract shows an increase to Rs.3000; C3-C5 concern government pensioners.

cited.quote: The Directorate continues to fill vacant posts through regular recruitment

rationale: C1 reports ongoing recruitment with 2025-26 figures (before the government took office) and temporary SMC teachers; no new official step to fill all vacant posts. C3-C5 concern training and sanitation.

cited.quote: Differently Abled Pension Scheme - Rs.1500 Rs.1500
grant of ₹2,000/-, without any income ceiling, to six categories of Differently Abled Persons.

rationale: C2 shows the differently abled pension at Rs.1500 and C3 a maintenance grant of Rs.2,000. No extract shows an increase to Rs.3000.

cited.quote: anganwadi employees are provided with special time scale of pay at the rate of Rs.7,700–24,200 for anganwadi workers

rationale: C2 shows anganwadi workers remain on a special time scale of pay; C4 also refers to Special Time Scale employees. No extract shows conversion to Grade D employees or an Rs.18,000 salary.

cited.quote: salt fortified with iron and iodine and oil fortified with vitamin A and D are used for cooking.

rationale: C2 concerns fortified oil and salt in anganwadi meals, a different setting; C4-C5 describe PDS rice, wheat and palmolein supply without fortified rice or wheat flour. No official step for distribution of fortified rice, oil and flour through ration shops.
C1-C2 concern ration family cards, C3 a Non-Resident Tamil insurance scheme, C4-C5 a gold ring scheme for newborns. None is about a Makkal Nalan Kaapeedu card worth Rs.25 lakh per family.
